post_clip.description: A man at the counter (left) appears to surreptitiously place an item into his shorts pocket or waistband while turning away from the counter and walking toward the exit; this behavior is consistent with shoplifting—concealing merchandise without payment. The woman near the display does not appear involved, but the man’s actions (quick hand movement near waist, immediate departure after interaction) are suspicious.

A woman in a white top and light shorts approaches the display shelf, picks up an item (appears to be a tablet or small electronic device), and quickly conceals it under her shirt/tank top while turning away from the camera. She then moves toward the right side of the frame, near the exit area, with her hands held close to her torso—consistent with concealing stolen merchandise. A second woman briefly interacts with her near the shelf, possibly acting as a lookout. The man at the counter remains distracted. This behavior strongly suggests shoplifting.
